candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing anyone to call it.
Replace the withdraw call with a sendMoney call to an arbitrary address, changing the destination of funds.
Replace withdraw with nothing, so withdrawAll does not transfer balance.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, allowing anyone to pass the modifier.
Replace the withdrawal transfer to send to a fixed address instead of msg.sender.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdraw.
Replace payable(msg.sender).transfer with a call that can fail silently, changing balance effect.
Delete the transfer statement so no funds are sent.
Replace _target.call with _target.transfer to change the fallback logic and gas forwarding behavior.
Replace call with delegatecall to execute the target's logic in the context of C, potentially changing C's own state.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so non-owners can call sendMoney and change the behavior observed by owner calls.
Change the modifier check to use tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing whitelisted contracts to bypass the check.
